accepted.title: Ablation: remove the boundary-anchored retain fidelity term
accepted.hypothesis: The weight-normalised 1-pixel boundary-band term (boundary_anchored_loss, BOUNDARY_WEIGHT=2.0, BOUNDARY_DILATE=3) is what lifts heldout_boundary_f1 and heldout_macro_dice; without it, utility components of combined_score drop while forget_retrain_probability_mae stays roughly unchanged.

accepted.title: Ablation: remove PCGrad-style ascent/retain orthogonalisation
accepted.hypothesis: Projecting out the retain-conflicting component of the ascent gradient (orthogonalize) is what prevents forgetting from cancelling retain-descent directions; with raw ascent gradients, heldout utility degrades and forget-patient divergence from clean Retrain becomes damage-driven rather than targeted.

accepted.title: Baseline: pure gradient ascent unlearning on forget patients
accepted.hypothesis: Generic gradient ascent - the naive unlearning extreme named in the task hypothesis and absent from the evaluator-owned comparison set - destroys forget-patient predictions without approximating clean Retrain and leaks damage into heldout utility, yielding a much lower combined_score than BAMOA.

accepted.title: Baseline: plain joint-step NegGrad+ on the same anchor/RPC skeleton
accepted.hypothesis: With the identical alternating-RPC structure and cached retain anchor but the plain NegGrad+ composition parameter.grad = retain_grad - 0.1 * ascent_grad (no boundary term, no orthogonalisation, no gate, no damping, no norm clamp), performance should land near the evaluator's split-step NegGrad+ and clearly below BAMOA, showing the gains come from the protections and boundary objective rather than the joint/anchor structure itself.

accepted.title: Baseline: boundary-anchored retain-only fine-tuning (no forgetting term)
accepted.hypothesis: If BAMOA's benefit were merely extra retain training under its boundary objective (Alternative 2), then boundary-anchored retain-only fine-tuning - the exact degenerate fallback BAMOA's own docstring describes - would match its combined_score; we expect it to preserve heldout utility but barely move forget-patient predictions away from Original, so forget_retrain_probability_mae stays near the Original's and the 0.5-weight MAE term keeps combined_score below BAMOA's.

rejected.title: Ablation: remove the self-closing memorization gate (gate fixed at 1)
Ablation: remove element-wise sensitivity damping (uniform damping = 1)
Ablation: remove the ascent-gradient norm clamp (ascent_scale fixed at 1)
